title: Efficiency
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0020 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Effective includes efficient. Every cut reports its effort: agent runs by role, rounds, whole-check runs and tokens. A cut whose figures show effort without convergence is stopped and diagnosed, not pushed through more rounds.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
